title: Trump Media shareholder United Atlantic Ventures reports stake reduced to 100 shares
short_description: A September 26, 2024 SEC filing reported a major shareholder’s reduced stake; peak-time selling and retail-loss allegations remain unverified.
medium_description: United Atlantic Ventures reported on September 26, 2024 that it held only 100 Trump Media shares. Its SEC filing identified Andrew Litinsky as managing member and said it had owned 7,525,000 shares at the March business combination. Reuters reported the stake reduction after selling restrictions ended. The evidence supports the ownership change, but not peak-price sales or resulting retail investor losses.
long_description: United Atlantic Ventures disclosed a sharply reduced stake in Trump Media & Technology Group in a Schedule 13G filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on September 26, 2024. The filing identified the company and Andrew Litinsky as reporting persons and described Litinsky as its managing member. It said United Atlantic Ventures had beneficially owned 7,525,000 common shares, representing 5.5 percent of the outstanding stock, when Trump Media’s business combination closed on March 25, 2024. By the filing date, the company reported holding 100 shares. The ownership table listed shared voting and disposition power over those remaining shares and reported the stake as 0.0 percent of the class. Reuters described United Atlantic Ventures as one of Trump Media’s largest shareholders and linked the reduction to the recent expiration of selling restrictions. Its report identified Litinsky as a Trump Media cofounder and former participant in The Apprentice. Trump Media operates the Truth Social platform.
